item.title: One dead as Hurricane Lala hits Hawaii's Big Island as Category 1 storm
item.description: Hurricane Lala brought heavy rain and the threat of life-threatening flooding and mudslides to Hawaii's Big Island.

item.title: Hurricane Lala, now Category 1, brings heavy rain and wind to Hawaii
item.description: Lala strengthened to a Category 1 hurricane as it moved through the central Pacific, approaching the Big Island on Saturday.

item.title: NATO fighter jet downs drone in Romania near Ukraine border
item.description: This is the latest in a series of incidents involving drone incursions into NATO airspace from Ukraine.

item.title: Virginia State shooting suspect arrested, found hiding in dorm closet
item.description: Police arrested a suspect in the early Saturday shooting at Virginia State University that wounded five people, one critically.
